chunks.text: Been thinking about a low-key afternoon in Chengdu sometime soon, like catching a movie if I’m not too wiped out.
And separately, I might be in Shenzhen mid-April, so I’ve been toying with the idea of doing a big meal with people there.
Also, if I end up staying with my cousin in Guangzhou, I might look into some home service stuff while I’m there, depending how chaotic things get.
If the timing works out in Chengdu, I’ve been eyeing YOLO at Pacific Cinema, maybe the 14:30 show, and it’d probably be 4 seats under Huang Tao.
For that Shenzhen meal idea, I keep coming back to Jiang Hotpot Shenzhen—maybe 2026-04-15 around 14:00, like 10 people, under David Liu.

If it even happens, I guess I’d put the hotpot thing down as a party size of 10 and use David Liu’s number 13899887766, and for the movie I was thinking 4 seats—though honestly I’m not sure I’ll actually do this.
